div.p: In 2007, the Immigration Museum and the University of Melbourne collaborated on a project to bring together women who had been active in the fight for migrant women’s rights in 1970s and 1980s Melbourne. The result was the exhibition Trailblazers: migrant women activists, which opened at the Immigration Museum in March 2008. It was the first time that the efforts of migrant women in combating disadvantage and discrimination had been thus celebrated.
